answer:
I've completed comprehensive research on TAC Protocol's TAC token. Here's the summary of key findings:

## TAC Protocol (TAC) — Key Findings (as of July 15, 2026)

**Current State:** TAC trades at **~$0.0029** with a market cap of **~$13–15M** (rank ~#1002). This is down **>95%** from its all-time high of ~$0.067 (June 30, 2026).

**The dominant story — July 2026 flash crash:**
- TAC crashed **~90% in ~15 minutes on July 7–8, 2026** (from ~$0.06 to ~$0.005)
- Team (July 9 statement) blamed a **perpetual-futures liquidation cascade** overwhelming thin spot liquidity — explicitly denying any hack or insider selling
- On-chain: 18 wallets bridged 372M TAC to BNB Chain, liquidating ~$1.78M
- A **+61.94% bounce** followed on July 10, then settled back to ~$0.0029
- Notably, this was TAC's **second ~90% crash** — the first was at its Binance Alpha listing on July 15, 2025

**Vesting/unlocks:** ~46–49% of the 10.03B supply is circulating. The seed allocation (16.6%) is on ~2-year linear vesting from July 15, 2025, with **monthly ~4% releases beginning right around July 15, 2026** — a live supply-pressure event. Team/Treasury tokens (40.5% combined) remain locked.

**Technicals (post-crash):** Support ~$0.0020 (defended), resistance ~$0.0073 then ~$0.0102; 50 EMA far overhead at ~$0.0192; RSI 34; short-term base case $0.0030–$0.0060.

**Data caveat:** Some sources (Phemex ~$0.046, Coinbase ~$0.0164) show stale pre/mid-crash snapshots; live trackers converge on ~$0.0029 as the current figure.
